items.how: Threshold working. (Retired: applicability is now worked out automatically from the client's figures.)
items.text: CSR applicability checked: net worth Rs 500 crore, turnover Rs 1,000 crore or net profit Rs 5 crore in the preceding year.

steps: Compute average net profits of the last 3 years
Compare with amount spent on eligible activities
items.text: At least 2% of average net profits of the last three years spent on eligible Schedule VII activities.

steps: Check transfers to Unspent CSR Account (30 days) or Schedule VII fund (6 months)
items.text: Unspent amount for ongoing projects moved to Unspent CSR Account within 30 days; other unspent amount to Schedule VII fund within six months.

steps: Obtain CSR-1 numbers of implementing agencies
items.text: Implementing agencies registered with CSR-1; utilisation certificates obtained.

steps: Check the annual action plan approval
items.text: CSR-2 filed and annual action plan approved.
